skills.name: Directory inventory
skills.description: Map a folder tree with sizes and counts before acting on it.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Run file.list on the target folder; note file count and types.
2. For large trees, list subfolders one level at a time instead of deep dumps.
3. Summarize the structure in one paragraph and flag anything unexpected.
4. Confirm scope with the user before deleting or moving anything.

skills.name: Safe file reading
skills.description: Read large files without blowing the context budget.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read with explicit line ranges; never read a 10k-line file end to end.
2. Read the first 50 lines to detect format (code, log, JSON, CSV).
3. Use file.search to jump to relevant sections instead of sequential reading.
4. Quote at most 20 lines in your answer; summarize the rest.

skills.name: Codebase search
skills.description: Find definitions, usages and literals across a project fast.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Start with file.search for the exact symbol or string.
2. Narrow by extension or folder when results explode.
3. Cross-check hits with file.read before claiming anything.
4. Report file:line references for every claim.

skills.name: File authoring
skills.description: Create new files with correct structure the first time.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Check with file.list and file.search that the target does not already exist.
2. Match the folder conventions (naming, headers, package paths).
3. Write the complete file with file.write; no TODO placeholders.
4. Re-read the file to verify content landed intact.

skills.name: Surgical patching
skills.description: Apply minimal, reviewable edits to existing files.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the exact region; capture surrounding lines as anchors.
2. file.patch the smallest possible span that fixes the issue.
3. Re-read the patched region to verify syntax and indentation.
4. State what changed in one sentence with a file:line reference.

skills.name: Safe deletion
skills.description: Remove files only with confirmation and a trail.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List exactly what will be deleted with file.list.
2. Confirm with the user when the target is outside the current task scope.
3. file.delete one target at a time; never wildcard deletes.
4. Verify the parent folder state afterwards.

skills.name: Workspace change audit
skills.description: Review recent workspace mutations before reporting done.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. If the folder is a git repo run git.status and git.diff; otherwise compare against your notes.
2. Enumerate every file you created or modified this session.
3. For each, state why the change was needed.
4. Flag leftover scratch files and offer to remove them with file.delete.

skills.name: Rename refactor
skills.description: Plan and execute a rename across a codebase.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search the old identifier everywhere and count hits.
2. Classify hits: definition, usage, comment, string literal.
3. Patch definitions first with file.patch, then usages in batches.
4. Re-search the old name; it must return zero hits before you report done.

skills.name: Duplicate finder
skills.description: Locate copy-pasted or redundant files in a tree.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.list to enumerate candidates with similar names or sizes.
2. file.read the heads of likely duplicates to compare content.
3. For real duplicates, recommend which to keep and justify.
4. Delete only after explicit user confirmation with file.delete.

skills.name: Bulk import triage
skills.description: Organize files dropped into the workspace for processing.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.list the drop folder; group by extension and apparent purpose.
2. file.read one sample per group to confirm the format.
3. Propose a target layout before moving anything.
4. Process groups in order; report counts per group.

skills.name: Log file triage
skills.description: Extract errors and patterns from large log files.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for ERROR, FATAL and Exception markers with a result cap.
2. file.read 20 lines around the first occurrences for context.
3. Group findings by root cause, not by timestamp.
4. Propose the single most likely fix; do not shotgun.

skills.name: CSV structure probe
skills.description: Understand a CSV shape before any processing.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the first 30 lines; identify delimiter, quoting, header row.
2. Count columns per row; flag ragged rows.
3. Propose a parsing strategy with python.run_file and the expected output shape.
4. Only then write the processing script.

skills.name: JSON structure probe
skills.description: Inspect large JSON without loading it all.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the first 40 lines to detect nesting style.
2. file.search for the keys you actually need.
3. Decide between targeted reads and a python.run_file extraction script.
4. Report the schema as one compact tree.

skills.name: Config file audit
skills.description: Review configuration for drift and contradictions.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for config keys relevant to the task (properties, yaml, toml).
2. file.read each hit; note values that contradict each other.
3. Propose a minimal set of corrections.
4. Apply with file.patch after user approval.

skills.name: Docstring extraction
skills.description: Build an API summary from docstrings and comments.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for def, class, fun and public declarations in target files.
2. file.read each definition with a few context lines.
3. Produce a table: symbol, signature, one-line purpose.
4. Flag public symbols missing documentation.

skills.name: Encoding repair
skills.description: Detect and fix mojibake and BOM issues in text files.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the suspicious region; look for replacement chars or doubled accents.
2. Identify the actual encoding from byte patterns with a python.run_file probe.
3. Convert with the script; write to a new file first.
4. Spot-check with file.read before replacing the original.

skills.name: Line-ending normalization
skills.description: Fix CRLF/LF mixing that breaks builds and diffs.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Detect carriage returns with a python.run_file byte scan.
2. Normalize with the script; count changed lines.
3. Re-run the build (gradle.exec or make.exec) to confirm nothing broke.
4. Recommend a gitattributes rule to prevent recurrence.

skills.name: Empty directory sweep
skills.description: Find and prune empty folders safely.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.list the tree; note folders with zero visible children.
2. Verify none are referenced by build files (file.search the folder names).
3. Delete with file.delete after listing them to the user.
4. Confirm the tree is still valid for the build.

skills.name: Size report
skills.description: Report which files dominate a folder size.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.list the folder; note sizes exposed by the tool output.
2. For the biggest candidates, check whether they are generated artifacts.
3. Recommend what to clean vs keep; generated builds and caches first.
4. Never delete without listing targets explicitly.

skills.name: README drafting
skills.description: Write a README that matches the actual code.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.list the project root; file.read build files to identify language and tooling.
2. Extract entry points and main modules with file.search.
3. Draft: purpose, requirements, build, run, project layout.
4. Verify every documented command against the real build files.

skills.name: TODO sweep
skills.description: Enumerate unfinished work markers in a codebase.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for TODO, FIXME and HACK markers with a result cap.
2. Classify: quick fix, real feature, stale leftover.
3. Present a table with file:line and classification.
4. Offer to fix the quick wins immediately with file.patch.

skills.name: License header application
skills.description: Add or fix license headers consistently.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for an existing header sample to copy the exact format.
2. Determine which files lack it via file.read of file tops.
3. Prepend headers with file.patch; never touch code lines.
4. Spot-check 3 files and re-run the build.

skills.name: Backup before risky edit
skills.description: Snapshot a file before large or destructive edits.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the target; file.write a copy next to it with a .bak suffix.
2. Announce the backup path to the user.
3. Proceed with the edit using file.patch or file.write.
4. Offer to delete the .bak once the change is verified.

skills.name: Workspace layout design
skills.description: Structure new project folders sensibly.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Ask for the project type if unclear (app, library, scripts, data).
2. Propose a layout following the dominant ecosystem convention.
3. Create the skeleton with file.write.
4. Summarize the layout as a tree in the chat.

skills.name: Safe symbol rename
skills.description: Rename a function or class without breaking callers.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search every occurrence of the symbol.
2. Read each usage context to catch string-based references (reflection, serialization).
3. Patch definitions, then callers, one file at a time with file.patch.
4. Build with gradle.exec, javac.exec or kotlinc.exec to prove it compiles.

skills.name: Template variable scan
skills.description: Find unfilled placeholders in generated files.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for TODO markers, mustache vars and dunder name tokens.
2. Classify which are intentional vs forgotten.
3. Fill the forgotten ones via file.patch using project context.
4. List anything you could not resolve.

skills.name: Binary file guard
skills.description: Avoid dumping binary content into chat context.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Detect binary files by extension or NUL bytes in a short file.read probe.
2. Never read binaries fully; use re.hex.identify or re.rabin2 for structure.
3. For media, state type and size instead of content.
4. Route analysis to the right specialized skill.

skills.name: File permission probe
skills.description: Diagnose why a file cannot be read or executed.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Try file.read on the target; capture the exact error.
2. Check ownership with process.exec ls -l on the parent.
3. For app-private files confirm sandbox scope; for shared storage note Android 11+ limits.
4. Escalate only via root.exec with user approval.

skills.name: Symlink audit
skills.description: Find symbolic links that may break builds or packaging.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. process.exec find with -type l in the workspace.
2. Resolve each target; flag dangling links.
3. Propose fixes: replace with real files or remove.
4. Apply with process.exec after confirmation.

skills.name: Lockfile audit
skills.description: Review dependency lockfiles for drift and conflicts.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the lockfiles: package-lock.json, gradle.lockfile, poetry.lock.
2. Look for duplicate major versions of the same library.
3. Cross-check declared deps in the manifest with file.search.
4. Propose the smallest alignment change.

skills.name: Generated code guard
skills.description: Never hand-edit generated files.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Detect generated files by header comments or folder conventions.
2. If a change is needed there, find the generator source with file.search.
3. Patch the source and regenerate via the build.
4. Explain the indirection to the user.

skills.name: Ignore-rules hygiene
skills.description: Keep .gitignore and packaging excludes correct.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read .gitignore; list build outputs present in file.list that should be ignored.
2. Propose added lines, most specific first.
3. Apply with file.patch.
4. Confirm with git.status that the noisy files disappear from tracking.

skills.name: Release notes from diffs
skills.description: Draft release notes from actual repository changes.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. git.log to find the previous release point; git.diff against HEAD.
2. Group changes: features, fixes, breaking, internal.
3. Write one bullet per user-visible change; skip refactors unless notable.
4. Verify every claim against the diff; never invent entries.

skills.name: Before/after snapshots
skills.description: Capture precise before/after evidence for edits.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the target region before editing; keep it in your notes.
2. Apply the change with file.patch.
3. file.read the same region after; present a compact before/after pair.
4. Keep evidence short: max 15 lines each side.

skills.name: Coordinated multi-file edit
skills.description: Apply one logical change across many files safely.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Plan the edit; list every file that must change (file.search for touchpoints).
2. Order edits: types and contracts first, then callers.
3. Patch each file with file.patch; verify each with a focused re-read.
4. Build at the end with gradle.exec, make.exec or node.exec; never report partial work as done.

skills.name: Workspace hygiene pass
skills.description: Keep the agent workspace clean between tasks.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.list the workspace root; identify scratch files from previous runs.
2. Propose deletions in one list; wait for approval.
3. file.delete approved items.
4. Suggest moving durable outputs into a dated folder.

skills.name: Unicode sanity audit
skills.description: Spot invisible characters corrupting code or data.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Byte-scan suspicious files with a python.run_file script for zero-width spaces, BOM and non-breaking spaces.
2. Report file:line and the codepoint found.
3. Normalize with the script; keep the original as .bak.
4. Re-run relevant tests or builds.

skills.name: Archive content probe
skills.description: Inspect zip and tar contents without full extraction.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. process.exec unzip -l or tar -tf to list entries.
2. Identify the interesting subset before extracting anything.
3. Extract selectively into a temp folder.
4. Clean up temp files when done.

skills.name: App manifest check
skills.description: Validate AndroidManifest basics before building.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read AndroidManifest.xml.
2. Verify package, permissions, activity exports and intent filters are coherent.
3. For binary or merged manifests use re.apk.manifest on the APK.
4. Report issues with line references.

skills.name: Asset map
skills.description: Catalog app static assets and their consumers.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.list the asset folders (res and assets directories).
2. file.search for each asset name to find consumers.
3. Report orphans (unreferenced) and missing (referenced but absent).
4. Propose cleanup or additions.

skills.name: Path traversal safety
skills.description: Prevent path escapes when handling user-supplied names.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Reject names containing dot-dot segments, absolute paths or separators before file operations.
2. Resolve the final path and confirm it stays under the workspace root.
3. Prefer file.list on the parent to validate existence.
4. Never follow a suspicious symlink into system directories.

skills.name: Large diff explanation
skills.description: Explain a big change set in reviewable order.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. git.diff (or before/after reads) and list touched files.
2. Order the explanation: contracts, then implementations, then tests.
3. One paragraph per file, max; link claims to file:line.
4. Call out anything that looks unintentional.

skills.name: Env file handling
skills.description: Handle env and secrets files without leaking values.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. If an env file must be read, list KEY names only; never echo values.
2. Warn the user before committing env files (file.search the .gitignore).
3. Provide an example template with placeholders instead.
4. Never memory.save secrets; they become permanent recall context.

skills.name: Large dump splitting
skills.description: Split oversized text dumps into analyzable chunks.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Probe the file size with a short file.read probe.
2. Split with a python.run_file script into N-line chunks with numeric suffixes.
3. Analyze chunks with file.search instead of reading all.
4. Merge conclusions across chunks; report totals.

skills.name: Folder tree comparison
skills.description: Diff two folder trees structurally.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.list both roots; capture entries.
2. Compare: missing, extra, renamed (same size different name heuristic).
3. For content diffs of suspects, use process.exec diff on the pairs.
4. Report a three-bucket summary.

skills.name: Pre-report final check
skills.description: Verify all promised artifacts exist before claiming done.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Re-list every file you claimed to create or edit with file.list.
2. file.read the critical sections to confirm the changes are present.
3. Re-run the quick verification command one last time.
4. Only then deliver the summary.

skills.name: Code review pass
skills.description: Review code changes like a senior reviewer.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Establish scope: git.diff or the touched files via file.list.
2. Read every changed hunk with file.read; correctness first, style second.
3. For each finding cite file:line and severity (blocker, major, minor).
4. End with a verdict: approve, approve-with-comments, or request-changes.

skills.name: Behavior-preserving refactor
skills.description: Refactor without changing observable behavior.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify the behavior contract: existing tests or usage sites (file.search).
2. Make the smallest structural change with file.patch.
3. Rebuild and run tests: gradle.exec, python.run_file or node.exec.
4. If tests cannot prove behavior, say so explicitly instead of assuming.

skills.name: Bug reproduction script
skills.description: Turn a bug report into a minimal reproduction.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Extract exact inputs and expected vs actual behavior from the report.
2. Build the smallest failing case with python.run_file or a unit test.
3. Confirm it fails before touching production code.
4. Keep the repro in the workspace and reference it in the fix summary.

skills.name: Regression test writing
skills.description: Lock a fixed bug with a focused test.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Reproduce the bug first with a minimal failing case.
2. Find the project test layout with file.list.
3. Add the minimal test that fails without the fix and passes with it.
4. Run the suite (gradle.exec, node.exec or python.run_file) and report counts.

skills.name: Minimal fix discipline
skills.description: Fix the reported bug only; resist scope creep.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Reproduce the exact reported failure.
2. Identify the single root cause; ignore adjacent issues but list them.
3. Apply the smallest correct patch with file.patch.
4. Verify with the original repro; mention adjacent issues as follow-ups.
